name: taxfax
description: TaxFax — stop chasing, start filing. Tax-season document collection for CPA firms.

scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:rules && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm --prefix web run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
